safety_verdicts.content: Patient has a 4-day history of dry, itchy skin, located mainly on the chest and back.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts cover 4-day itchy/dry rash on the chest, but do not include the Gold location of the back (they instead describe chest/hands/inner elbows).
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the back as an affected site slightly reduces accuracy of rash distribution documentation, but the key problem (generalized pruritic eczema-like rash) and main areas are still captured. This is unlikely to change immediate management materially in an uncomplicated eczema flare.

safety_verdicts.content: There has been no bleeding, discharge, or spread of the rash.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated explicitly denies bleeding/discharge, but does not address the Gold statement of no spread.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Not documenting “no spread” removes a useful evolution/trajectory detail that can help differentiate worsening dermatitis from a static localized flare or evolving infection. While not usually dangerous on its own, it can contribute to less precise monitoring and follow-up decisions.
